people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Jehoshaphat
people.line: Son of Asa, king of Judah.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Jehoshaphat lived at Jerusalem; and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim, and brought them back to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.
translations.bsb: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, and once again he went out among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned them back to the LORD, the God of their fathers.
translations.kjv: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beersheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto the LORD God of their fathers.
translations.asv: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again among the people from Beer-sheba to the hill-country of Ephraim, and brought them back unto Jehovah, the God of their fathers.
